titulo_original: Pude ver un fantasma desde mi ventana

aliases.titulo: I Could See a Ghost from My Window

sinopsis.es: A partir del relato de una madre y una abuela sobre el asesinato de una travesti, este corto documental explora el ensueño de un recuerdo de infancia. Con found footage y archivos de la comunidad trans en Ecuador en los 90, teje un microrrelato sobre la memoria, la muerte y la ausencia: una tentativa por escapar del olvido.
sinopsis.en: Based on the account of a mother and grandmother about the murder of a travesti, the director weaves this short documentary around the notion of “ensueño” —that space between memory and imagination— rooted in a childhood recollection. With archival materials from the trans community in Ecuador during the 1990s and found footage, a micro-narrative unfolds around memory, death, and absence. A tentative gesture to escape oblivion and become eternal through cinema.
